title: In My Father's Room (HKAFF)
synopsis:
After receiving a key to her late father's room, art museum employee Satomi traces his final days and discovers a man who found quiet comfort in language, tea ceremony and small beauty, recognising the grace in how he lived. Adapted from her eponymous short story, novelist-turned-director Maha Harada's debut feature weaves together the wabi-sabi of tea ceremony and the delicateness of poetry, presenting a personal tale of father-daughter relationship that gradually unfolds like the rectangular color block drawn by abstract painter Mark Rothko.

 

San Sebastian International Film Festival

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
在美術館工作的聰美每天認真地坐在展廳，在抽象藝術家Mark Rothko 作品的陪伴下，看着熙來攘往的參觀者。一天，她收到一個月前孤獨離世的父親寄來的「生日包裹」，內有一條鑰匙。聰美開始追溯父親晚年的生活及興趣。就算鍾情於他人眼中的「無用之物」又如何？在「無用」中尋覓美的身影，所感 所受亦是個人最彌足珍貴的時刻。著名作家原田舞葉初執導筒，改編同名 短篇小説，在茶道的侘寂與文字的芳醇間細味父女間的淡淡感情，猶如Mark Rothko 繪畫的長方體，承載無以名狀的情感。

 

聖塞巴斯提昂國際電影節

cast: Yu Aoi, Eita Nagayama, Issey Ogata
